testCases.name: Dashboard Page Loads Successfully
testCases.description: Verify dashboard page loads with all required UI elements
testCases.precondition: User is logged in with valid vedak.com credentials
steps: Check page title contains 'Dashboard' or similar
Check main content area is displayed
testCases.expectedResult: Dashboard page loads with all UI elements visible and properly rendered

testCases.name: Vedak Logo Visibility and Clickability
testCases.description: Verify Vedak logo is visible and clickable on dashboard
testCases.precondition: User is on dashboard page
steps: Verify logo is visible and properly rendered
Check logo is clickable (cursor changes to pointer)
testCases.expectedResult: Vedak logo is visible, properly rendered, and shows hover effect

testCases.name: Click Vedak Logo Redirect
testCases.description: Verify clicking Vedak logo redirects to home/dashboard
testCases.precondition: User is on dashboard page with logo visible
steps: Check current URL and page title
testCases.expectedResult: User is redirected to home/dashboard page after clicking logo

testCases.name: Page Refresh Functionality
testCases.description: Verify page refresh works without losing data/session
testCases.precondition: User is on dashboard page
steps: Refresh the page using F5 or browser refresh
Wait for page to fully load
Verify page reloads with same URL
Check all elements are still visible
testCases.expectedResult: Page refreshes successfully, retains session, and all data persists
